card.name: Small words right before water or liquid
card.fires_on: Small linking words (with, in, of, but, either, Add) that come just before a liquid such as water, soap and water, or a diluent in handling, mixing or rinsing instructions.

modes.label: Washing after contact
modes.description: The word 'with' or 'of' before soap and water in skin-contact instructions.
modes.example: wash exposed area immediately and thoroughly<< with>> soap and water.

modes.label: Dissolving or diluting
modes.description: The word 'in' after dissolve or disintegrate, before water or a solution.
modes.example: disintegrate NITYR<< in>> water and administer using an oral syringe

modes.label: Flushing or adding liquid
modes.description: Small words such as 'either' or 'Add' before a diluent or fluid.
modes.example: administration of pantoprazole sodium for injection with<< either>> 5% Dextrose Injection or
